rows.label: Communal taxes (no housing tax)
rows.value: There is no housing tax (taxe d'habitation); the communes levy a local equipment tax on owners (rate set each year by the communes), a household waste tax, and a water tax in Saint-Pierre (water charge in Miquelon-Langlade). Landlords file a lease duty (droit de bail) return by 31 January.
